第 4 部分

双方主张

未询问裁判员与法官：POL-RD-25 的 2 公里上限（the deviation is over the POL-RD-25 ceiling this policy applies to an AI ruling, so the ruling does not stand）。

乘客方主张

主张 1

The deviation is established on the platform's own recorded distances. The trip record shows 22.0 km actually driven against a 19.7 km recommended route via the ECP, a deviation of 2.30 km — more than double POL-RD-22's 1.0 km tolerance — so this is not a tolerance case and the POL-RD-24 refund matrix is engaged.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-22, POL-RD-24

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 2

The reroute was not traffic-justified. The only traffic data for the recommended route is LTA-TI-260826-8661, which records no incident, roadwork or closure on the ECP (towards City) between Tanah Merah Coast Road and Benjamin Sheares Bridge in the trip window, rates speed bands 5-7 throughout, and carries type NONE — which is not one of the incident, congestion or closure types POL-RD-23 names; the artifact itself computes justifies_reroute as false. The driver's bare assertion that 'ECP sometimes jam near Marina' is an assertion with no supporting traffic data, and POL-RD-23 says a driver's assertion with no such data does not justify the reroute.

证据编号: EV-ADVIS-05010-01

条款编号: POL-RD-23

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 3

The driver did not inform the rider of the deviation, as POL-RD-21 requires him to do before or at the point of deviation. The chat log holds two messages and both are before the pickup — the driver's 'at pick-up point lane B' and the rider's answer about luggage — and the trip record's messages_during_trip list is empty; there are no in-app calls in the record. Under POL-RD-21 a verbal notice with no recording in the record cannot be established, so the notice obligation is not met on any source in this file.

证据编号: EV-CHAT-05010, EV-TRIP-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-21

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 4

The driver's answer that the 'passenger never say anything during the ride' is not a defence. POL-RD-21 puts the duty to inform on the driver before or at the point of deviation, and it counts the rider's acknowledgment — not the rider's silence — as agreement to a deviation; the chat log shows no message from either party between trip start at 14:33:20 and trip end at 14:59:50.

证据编号: EV-CHAT-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-21

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 5

The GPS trace fixes which route was taken and when, which is exactly the use POL-RD-22 makes of it. The vehicle ran on the Pan-Island Expressway from 14:36:50, then Sims Way and Lavender Street, and rejoined the recommended route only at Victoria Street / Lavender Street at 14:58:48 — about 22 minutes off the recommended ECP route. That is not a momentary sidestep around an obstruction; it is the route the driver chose to drive, and no advisory on the file explains it.

证据编号: EV-GPS-05010, EV-ADVIS-05010-01

条款编号: POL-RD-22

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 6

On those facts the case falls in row (d) of POL-RD-24 — not traffic-justified, deviation over 1 km — and the excess distance fare is refunded in full. That fare is the deviation distance at the base per-km rate, without surge: 2.30 km x 0.92 SGD = 2.12 SGD, which matches the fare breakdown's own computed excess distance fare.

证据编号: EV-FARE-05010, EV-TRIP-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-24

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 7

The rider asks for the whole 36.30 SGD fare back, and that part of the claim is not what the policy provides: POL-RD-24 quantifies the deviation's monetary effect at the excess distance fare only, here 2.12 SGD, and no row of the matrix returns the base fare, the time fare or the airport surcharge for the 22.0 km actually driven. A PARTIAL_REFUND of 2.12 SGD is the sum this record supports — and it is a rider win in POL-GEN-03 terms, because it leaves the rider not carrying the deviation charge.

证据编号: EV-FARE-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-24, POL-GEN-03

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 8

The confidence bar for this case is POL-GEN-22's 0.80 and not the 0.95 flag bar: the rider profile and the driver profile each carry fraud_flags of 0, and the contested amount is 36.30 SGD, inside the 10.00-50.00 SGD band. Every artifact relied on above is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no discount applies to the facts the rider's case rests on.

证据编号: EV-RPROF-05010, EV-DPROF-05010

条款编号: POL-GEN-22

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 9

The deviation of 2.30 km is over POL-RD-25's 2 km ceiling on an AI ruling, so this case cannot be ruled by the AI and must go to a human reviewer, with the file recording the measured deviation, the advisory that shows no justifying traffic condition and the empty in-trip chat log. On POL-GEN-03's own terms ESCALATE is terminal, no monetary outcome issues and the amount is held — so the disputed sum is held for that reviewer rather than confirmed against the rider.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05010, EV-ADVIS-05010-01

条款编号: POL-RD-25, POL-GEN-03

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

司机方主张

主张 1

No row of POL-RD-24 returns the whole trip fare the rider is asking for. The only two rows that pay anything — (b), traffic-justified but the rider not informed, and (d), not traffic-justified — both refund only the excess distance fare, which POL-RD-24 fixes as the deviation distance times the base per-km rate without surge: 2.30 km x 0.92 SGD = 2.12 SGD, the same figure the fare breakdown's own money block computes. So the rider's demand for the entire 36.30 SGD charged at 14:59:56 must fail; on this record the most the rider can ever recover is 2.12 SGD and the rest of the charge stands.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05010, EV-FARE-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-24, POL-GEN-03

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 2

This case cannot be ruled by the AI at all, and that is the outcome the driver should have. The deviation is 2.30 km, above the 2.0 km ceiling POL-RD-25 sets for an AI ruling, and the trip record's own deviation block flags that ceiling as applied and the case as over it. POL-RD-25 is not discretionary: an AI ruling on a route deviation stands only where the deviation is 2 km or less, so this dispute goes to a human reviewer. Under POL-GEN-03 an escalated case issues no monetary outcome and the amount is held, so no refund is paid now — which is better for the driver than the PARTIAL_REFUND of 2.12 SGD the matrix would otherwise produce, and far better than the 36.30 SGD the rider seeks. The driver cannot reach NO_ACTION (the deviation is over the 1.0 km tolerance and no traffic data justifies the reroute), so escalation is the best result the record permits.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-25, POL-GEN-22, POL-GEN-03

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 3

I concede traffic justification. The LTA advisory for the recommended route, the ECP towards the City between Tanah Merah Coast Road and Benjamin Sheares Bridge, records advisory type NONE with speed bands 5-7 and no incident, roadwork or closure anywhere in the trip window. Under POL-RD-23 the driver's statement that ECP sometimes jams near Marina is an assertion with no traffic data behind it and cannot justify the reroute, so rows (a) and (b) of POL-RD-24, the traffic-justified rows, are unavailable. That concession costs the driver nothing beyond what the matrix already gives: with the deviation above the 1.0 km tolerance the ceiling stays at the excess distance fare of 2.12 SGD, never the 36.30 SGD the rider claims.

证据编号: EV-ADVIS-05010-01, EV-TRIP-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-23, POL-RD-24

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 4

The record does not establish that the driver told the rider of the deviation before or at the point of deviation. The chat log carries only two messages, both about the pick-up lane, and the trip record's in_app_calls list is empty, so there is no call recording either; under POL-RD-21 a verbal notice with no recording cannot be established, and the rider's silence during the ride is not the acknowledgment the clause requires. So no 'informed and agreed' outcome is available. That does not help the rider on the money: rows (b) and (d) of POL-RD-24 both pay the same excess distance fare, so the notice question cannot lift the refund above 2.12 SGD.

证据编号: EV-CHAT-05010, EV-TRIP-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-21, POL-RD-24

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

主张 5

The rider's complaint that 'the whole ride felt like a detour' is not what the platform recorded. The trip record logs a single substitution: the vehicle left the recommended route at the Airport Boulevard / PIE-ECP split at 14:36:54 and rejoined it at Victoria Street / Lavender Street at 14:58:48 — 2.30 km of extra distance on a 19.7 km recommended route, 11.7 per cent. POL-RD-22 fixes the deviation on the platform's recorded distances, and on those recorded distances the excess is 2.30 km, not the whole journey. Nothing in this record supports handing back the full fare.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05010, EV-GPS-05010

条款编号: POL-RD-22, POL-RD-24

裁判员结论: 没有裁判员结论。

当事人陈述、双方主张与裁决说明原文为英文。

第 5 部分

法官草稿

未询问裁判员与法官：POL-RD-25 的 2 公里上限（the deviation is over the POL-RD-25 ceiling this policy applies to an AI ruling, so the ruling does not stand）。

没有草稿：未询问法官。

第 6 部分

裁决说明

Under POL-RD-25, the deviation is over the POL-RD-25 ceiling this policy applies to an AI ruling, so the ruling does not stand. The AI prepared the case file -- both advocates were asked -- and no ruling is issued, so the dispute is escalated to a human reviewer with both amounts null and no referral. The reason code is V7_AI_LIMIT.

当事人陈述、双方主张与裁决说明原文为英文。
